operations.body:
Decisions recorded 2026-09-15 with Dylan, closing the deleted decision task:

1. Workbench moves in under desktop/ and keeps its name; tylerkilgore/workbench is archived once a desktop release has been cut from here.
2. Signing: ad-hoc signed and unnotarized on macOS for now, as Workbench ships today; Windows signs through Azure Trusted Signing when the secrets exist. Notarization is its own task.
3. Versions: two numbers. The CLI keeps vX.Y.Z; the app has its own sequence tagged desktop-vX.Y.Z, and every CLI release cuts a companion desktop release automatically. Releases live here, with a rolling desktop-latest release for the update check and the site. See the publish task.
4. Scope of the move: the sidebar and import only. The merged queue and the people directory leave as single commits and come back through their own tasks. Creating a project in a chosen folder and putting the bundled CLI on PATH are their own tasks too.
5. Every follow-on task depends on this one.
